verdicts.label: FALSE
verdicts.what_is_true_en: COVID-19 vaccines do not contain microchips for tracking people. Numerous health authorities and fact-checking organizations have confirmed that the vaccines contain only the necessary ingredients to generate an immune response.
verdicts.reasoning_en: A large body of evidence from multiple independent, high-tier fact-checking organizations (including FactCheck.org, AFP Fact Check, and Tempo.co) consistently and unanimously debunks the claim that COVID-19 vaccines contain microchips for tracking. These sources clarify that any tracking mechanisms, such as barcodes on vials, are for logistical purposes like tracking distribution, not for tracking individuals. Related claims involving magnets, Bill Gates, or misconstrued reports have also been repeatedly proven false.
